claims.claim_text: Kratos has a $400M IDIQ contract for development, integration, and prototype air vehicle delivery in support of the Air Force's Skyborg program, with the Skyborg Delivery Order 2 ($37.7M Dec 2020) integrating XQ-58A Valkyrie. Kratos stated it remains committed to a 2023 Skyborg Vanguard Program of Record.

claims.claim_text: Kratos's XQ-58A Valkyrie was awarded under the AFRL Low Cost Attritable Strike Demonstration (LCASD) program. Kratos is currently producing 12 Valkyrie drones (some funded by government contracts, others built on Kratos's own funds in advance of customer contracts), positioning for AFRL's Autonomous Collaborative Platforms (ACP) line and Air Force Collaborative Combat Aircraft / future autonomous wingman programs.

The LCASD UCAS, or Valkyrie ... producing 12 Valkyrie drones systems, certain of which are pursuant to funded government contracts with the others currently being produced with Kratos funds in advance of customer contracts

claims.claim_text: Kratos is the sole-source provider of the BQM-177A Sub-Sonic Aerial Target (SSAT) to the U.S. Navy. To date, Kratos has been awarded production orders for 257 BQM-177A aerial targets. The SSAT program is one of the largest and most important to Kratos. Most recent: $50.9M 2021 modification for 65 additional units.

claims.claim_text: Kratos is the sole-source provider of the BQM-167A Air Force Subscale Aerial Target (AFSAT) to the U.S. Air Force; has produced 508 BQM-167A targets to date; $109M three-year IDIQ awarded 2018.

claims.claim_text: Kratos is teamed with Dynetics on the DARPA Gremlins program (X-61A Gremlins Air Vehicle); successful in-flight capture demonstrated Q4 2021, satisfying major technical and program milestones.

claims.claim_text: Kratos received a $17.6M October 2021 contract to design and develop an Off Board Sensing Station (OBSS) Unmanned Aerial System in support of AFRL's Autonomous Collaborative Platforms (ACP) technology maturation portfolio. General Atomics also awarded a Phase 1 OBSS contract.
